# Combat > Stats

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md)*

A combatant's defensive numbers and turn order: Armor Class, Hit Points, Initiative and size.

## Entries

- [Armor Class](Armor-Class.md): An Armor Class (AC) is the target number for an attack roll.
- [Armor Training](Armor-Training.md): Armor training allows you to use armor of a certain category without the following drawbacks.
- [Hit Point Dice](Hit-Point-Dice.md): Hit Point Dice, or Hit Dice for short, help determine a player character's Hit Point maximum, as explained in "Creating a Character".
- [Hit Points](Hit-Points.md): Hit Points (HP) are a measure of how difficult it is to kill or destroy a creature or an object.
- [Initiative](Initiative.md): Initiative determines the order of turns during combat.
- [Size](Size.md): A creature or an object belongs to a size category: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, or Gargantuan.
- [Temporary Hit Points](Temporary-Hit-Points.md): Temporary Hit Points are granted by certain effects and act as a buffer against losing real Hit Points.
